#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""browser-ctl: find the browsers installed right now and open one of them for automation.

Nothing is hardcoded: every call re-reads the desktop entries (system, ~/.local, Flatpak)
with Categories=WebBrowser, so installing or removing a browser changes the list at once.
The engine is detected from the browser's own `--version` (cached per desktop file + mtime).

  browser-ctl list [--json]        installed browsers: id, name, engine, how it is driven, state
  browser-ctl status [ID]          which browser holds the automation port (exit 0 ready)
  browser-ctl start ID [URL]       open ID with its automation port (no-op if already ready)
  browser-ctl restart ID [URL]     close ID gracefully (tabs restore) and reopen it with the port
  browser-ctl stop ID              close ID gracefully
  browser-ctl match "TEXT"         ids of installed browsers named in TEXT (for the context engine)

Exit codes: 0 ready/ok, 1 not running/not found, 3 running WITHOUT the port (restart needs
the user's OK), 4 another browser holds the port, 5 engine cannot be automated (use the
desktop-control skill: real cursor + `see`).

Engines and MCP servers:
  chromium (Brave, Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Opera, Vivaldi, Helium, ...) -> CDP on 127.0.0.1:9222 -> `my-browser`
  gecko    (Firefox, LibreWolf, Zen, Floorp, Waterfox, ...)            -> Marionette 127.0.0.1:2828 -> `my-firefox`
  qtwebengine (qutebrowser)                                            -> CDP 9222, experimental -> `my-browser`
The ports are bound to 127.0.0.1 and opened only on demand: while open, any local process
can control that profile.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import configparser, glob, json, os, re, shlex, signal, socket, subprocess, sys, time, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

CDP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("BROWSER_CDP_PORT", "9222"))
MARIONETTE_PORT = int(os.environ.get("BROWSER_MARIONETTE_PORT", "2828"))
BIDI_PORT = int(os.environ.get("BROWSER_BIDI_PORT", "9223"))  # Firefox's default 9222 would collide with CDP
CACHE = Path.home() / ".config/opencode/state/browsers.json"
LOG = Path("/var/tmp/pip-scratch/opencode/browser-ctl.log")
GENERIC = {"web", "browser", "google", "mozilla", "microsoft", "the", "internet", "-", "(flatpak)"}
MCP = {"chromium": "my-browser", "qtwebengine": "my-browser", "gecko": "my-firefox"}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ discovery

def app_dirs() -> list[Path]:
